stock.description: Vico International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company with a primary focus on distributing third-party branded petrochemicals across key markets including Hong Kong, Macau, Vietnam, and Malaysia. Its product offerings include diesel, various lubricant oils (both its own brand and other manufacturers' brands), and other petrochemical substances like bitumen and kerosene. Beyond product sales, the company also provides transportation services and manages fleet card accounts, with over 51,000 active accounts as recorded on March 31, 2022. Established in 1977 and based in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong, the firm was formerly known as Rico International Holdings Limited until its rebranding in May 2017. It operates as a subsidiary of Max Fortune Holdings Limited.
